baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَلَمْ تَرَ ... ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ... أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening alert recruits the addressee as a witness, the signs function as visible coordinates, and the directional interrogative exposes the passive turning of the disputants as an orientation failure occurring in full view of those coordinates.

activation_trace.role: The alert-and-report use of seeing turns the question into a demand that the addressee notice and account for the scene.
The conspicuous-marker image makes the divine signs orientation points rather than merely topics of debate.
The interrogative can probe direction, manner, or condition, keeping both destination and mechanism open.
Turning something back from its face supplies the spatial core of their passive loss of orientation.

changed_reading.before: A general rebuke of people who argue about divine revelation.
changed_reading.after: A witnessed orientation puzzle: plainly marked coordinates remain present while the disputants are passively turned away from their proper face.

baseline_models.mechanism: The disputation evokes both tightly twisted material and entangled verbal contest, while the speech branch of turning evokes language made to incline hearers. The passive ending reverses agency: people who manipulate discourse are themselves caught in its turning action.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies a material model for an argument whose strands are deliberately wound together.
Reciprocal verbal contest grounds the model in the actual argumentative construction.
Speech embellished so that ears or hearts incline supplies the discourse-level turning mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They dispute first and are diverted in a separate second event.
changed_reading.after: Their mode of disputation already performs verbal turning, and the passive close makes that manipulative machinery recoil upon its users.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah defines this disputation as an attempt to remove truth's footing by means of what lacks reality, while later repetitions deny it compelling authority and locate its pressure in self-magnification. The focus passive then reads as a reversal: those trying to displace truth are themselves displaced.

activation_trace.role: Deflection from a face is the focus outcome onto which the attempted displacement rebounds.
The verbal contest is explicitly placed inside an instrumental and purposive sequence.
Loss of truth and stability identifies the unstable material used in the contest.
The slipping-foot image gives the attempted argumentative defeat a concrete displacement mechanism.
Stable correspondence with reality is the footing that the disputants try to make slip.
The compelling-proof branch clarifies what their dispute lacks.
Magnification inside the chest supplies an internal pressure that substitutes for absent proof.

structural_cues: 40:4, 40:35, and 40:56 repeat the dispute-in-the-signs construction found at 40:69.
40:5 gives the earlier dispute a purpose clause: falsehood is used in order to dislodge truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula, unstable falsehood, slipping imagery, absent compelling proof, and inward magnification; I supply the rebound arrow from their attempted displacement of truth to their own passive displacement. A live alternative is that the two displacements are related consequences without poetic reversal.

changed_reading.before: The disputants happen to be turned away while they argue.
changed_reading.after: Their turning answers the very tactic of their argument: an effort to unseat stable truth rebounds as loss of their own footing and direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby formula فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ closely matches the focus interrogative and passive syntax. Its turning-over branch, followed by another passive and conscious denial of signs, sharpens the focus from unspecified diversion into inversion away from a known and marked orientation.

activation_trace.role: The broad focus deflection receives a more specific directional quality from the parallel context.
The repeated directional interrogative establishes the closest grammatical analogue to the focus question.
Turning a thing over and away from its face specifies inversion rather than mere wandering.
Falsehood diverted from truth gives the repeated passive turning an epistemic direction.
The marked signs remain present immediately after the inversion formula.
Denial despite knowledge makes the inversion culpable rather than merely informational.

structural_cues: 40:62 has the same أَنَّى plus passive-verb frame as 40:69.
40:63 immediately repeats the passive ء ف ك verb and attaches it to rejection of divine signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tight grammatical parallel and branches of inversion, falsehood, visible marking, and knowing denial; I infer that the parallel sharpens the direction of ص ر ف. The live alternative is that ص ر ف remains broader and should not be treated as a synonym of ء ف ك.

changed_reading.before: The passive turning has an unspecified direction and may be simple distraction.
changed_reading.after: The turning is an inversion of orientation away from signs that remain recognizable, with denial operating despite knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh monopolizes the visual field by showing only what he himself claims to see and names his route as guidance. The subsequent tower and claimed connections manufacture an alternative line of sight; adornment and blockage then expose that line as engineered diversion. The focus appeal to the addressee's own seeing resists such curated vision.

activation_trace.role: The direct alert to the addressee opens an independent witnessing position.
Deflection from a face anchors the social mechanism back in the focus passive.
Causative showing joined to the ruler's own seeing creates an exclusive gate over what others may view.
Gentle direction toward a path is claimed by the ruler and thereby becomes a contested guidance function.
The extended traversable route gives the claimed guidance a spatial channel.
The high structure turns the ruler's claim into a built apparatus of seeing.
A rope or connection supplies the imagined means by which the manufactured route is supposed to reach its object.
Making something appear fine explains how the substitute route acquires persuasive surface appeal.
Explicit turning away supplies the resulting blockage of orientation.
The path recurs as the route from which Pharaoh is barred, reversing his claim to guide it.

structural_cues: 40:29 doubles the restrictive construction: I show you only what I see, and I guide you only to the right path.
40:36-37 moves from that claim to building and ascent, then closes with a passive barring from the path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies monopolized showing, claimed guidance, a built ascent, an adorned deed, and passive blockage; I infer a social and architectural mechanism by which vision can be curated and direction engineered. A live alternative is that the sequence diagnoses Pharaoh alone rather than the disputants as a class.

changed_reading.before: Their diversion is an unexplained inward error.
changed_reading.after: Diversion can be engineered through controlled seeing, prestigious construction, and a substitute route advertised as guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation carries the disputants from passive turning into connected restraints, passive dragging, firing, and commanded entry through gates. The focus question therefore begins a trajectory: loss of epistemic direction becomes externally imposed bodily routing.

activation_trace.role: Turning away from a face initiates the route that the following passives make concrete.
A collar that constrains an organ converts loss of direction into bodily restriction.
Connected links provide the mechanism that transmits imposed movement.
Dragging and extending supplies the explicit forced locomotion.
Kindling and intensifying fire gives the route its immediate terminal environment.
Entry into an interior marks arrival rather than indefinite wandering.
The gate image specifies the threshold through which the imposed route terminates.

structural_cues: 40:69-70 links consecutive descriptions with ٱلَّذِينَ, moving from disputing to denial before announcing future knowledge.
The passive sequence يُصْرَفُونَ, يُسْحَبُونَ, and يُسْجَرُونَ is followed by the command ٱدْخُلُوا۟.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies linked relative clauses, ordered passives, restraints, dragging, fire, and gates; I infer one progressively concretized route for the same class. A live alternative is that the later punishments describe consequences without feeding a bodily sense back into ص ر ف.

changed_reading.before: They are intellectually diverted, with no route or endpoint specified.
changed_reading.after: The passive diversion is the first stage of a coercive route that becomes bodily, linked, dragged, and finally directed through an endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly presents signs as something God actively shows, associates fruitful recollection with turning back, and later asks which shown signs can be denied. At the close, the deniers finally see overwhelming force, but that sight no longer makes belief beneficial. The focus appeal to seeing is thus temporally urgent: it offers recognition before sight becomes coercive and too late.

activation_trace.role: Direct perception anchors the focus as a live act of witnessing.
Active showing makes the signs offered evidence rather than hidden objects.
Habitual return supplies the responsive reorientation available when the signs are shown.
The repeated act of making signs visible extends the offered window of recognition.
The doubled marker language heightens the abundance and visibility of orientation points.
Refusal of recognition names the failed response to what has been shown.
The same seeing root returns when perception is forced by the arrival of might.
Overwhelming force changes seeing from offered evidence into coercive encounter.
The explicit loss of benefit marks the closure of the responsive window.
Repeated late seeing confirms that perception itself is not enough once its time has passed.

structural_cues: 40:13 and 40:81 repeat the act of God showing His signs.
40:84-85 repeat seeing the divine might and explicitly state that the resulting belief no longer benefits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated showing, return, denial, late seeing, and lost benefit; I supply the temporal arrow from offered sight to coercive sight. A live alternative is that these are separate examples of seeing rather than one closing window.

changed_reading.before: Have you not seen is a timeless rhetorical formula.
changed_reading.after: Have you not seen opens a time-sensitive opportunity to recognize shown signs before an unavoidable sight arrives too late to reorient beneficially.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The move from a tightly twisted strand to linked restraints is a surprising material analogy, not a claim that the two roots are synonyms or that speech literally becomes chain. It remains valid because the focus dispute carries the twisting branch and the immediately following scene supplies collars, links, and dragging; downstream prose should say the argument evokes or foreshadows its restraint.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُجَٰدِلُونَ, anchored in the tight-twisting branch of ج د ل

activation_trace.role: A tightly twisted cord gives the verbal act a latent material shape.
Connected links harden the earlier twisting image into a sequence of restraint.
The constraining collar supplies the bodily function of the linked material.
Dragging shows the restraint transmitting forced direction.

changed_reading.before: Argument and later chains belong to separate verbal and punitive domains.
changed_reading.after: The tightly wound argument can be heard as materially foreshadowing the connected restraint that later binds and directs its speakers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain comparison between ontological transformation and moral orientation, so it should not be rendered as the lexical meaning of يُصْرَفُونَ or as a stated causal claim. It remains anchored in the focus branch of transfer from state to state and in the immediately preceding ordered creation sequence; downstream prose should mark the paradox as an exploratory contrast.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُصْرَفُونَ, anchored in transfer from one state or face to another

activation_trace.role: Transfer from state to state permits a contrast between ordered transformation and disordered reorientation.
Formed bodily shape supplies the completed configuration against which later misorientation is paradoxical.
Creative bringing-into-being initiates the ordered sequence of state changes.
The drop-to-water range contributes a concrete early material state.
Attachment and adherence supply the next materially distinct state.
Repeated arrival at a limit makes the life sequence directional and goal-marked.
Immediate coming-to-be closes the ordered transformation frame directly before the focus.

changed_reading.before: Their diversion is unrelated to the creation sequence immediately before it.
changed_reading.after: Beings carried through ordered, goal-marked transformations are paradoxically carried into a disordered orientation when they confront the signs of the one who formed them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The currency-exchange branch of ص ر ف is form-distant from the focus passive and must not be offered as its translation. It remains worth carrying because the opening occurrence of the same dispute is paired with deceptive circulation through lands and reversal of face; downstream prose should present only an economic analogy in which fixed signs are treated as negotiable values.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُصْرَفُونَ, anchored in the exchange and differential-value branch of ص ر ف

activation_trace.role: Exchange between monies and differential value opens a deliberately distant market analogy for their turning.
Reversing a thing from its face links visible circulation to repeated revaluation and reorientation.
A glittering but unstable deception explains why circulation can look like validating success.
Bounded lands provide the social space through which the deceptive circulation occurs.

changed_reading.before: Their movement through lands is merely external prosperity, unrelated to the focus turning.
changed_reading.after: Their deceptive circulation can analogically become a market of orientation, where stable signs are treated as exchangeable and apparent success keeps repricing what counts as truth.

strongest_changes: 40:5 makes the attempted displacement of truth rebound into the disputants' own passive displacement.
The أَنَّى plus passive parallel at 40:62-63 sharpens generic turning into inversion away from recognized signs.
The passive sequence after 40:69 materializes loss of orientation as restraint, dragging, firing, and entry through a terminal gate.
The surah's repeated showing and late seeing turn أَلَمْ تَرَ into a time-sensitive invitation to recognize before sight becomes coercive.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made one short question operate simultaneously as an epistemic orientation test, a reversal of argumentative tactics, a diagnosis of socially engineered vision, and the opening of a bodily route. The most distinctive activations were the direct أَنَّى passive parallel and the material continuity from twisted dispute to linked restraint.
remaining_uncertainties: The relative-clause continuation strongly suggests one class across 40:69-71, but the exact degree of syntactic identity remains open.
The controlled-seeing mechanism may diagnose Pharaoh specifically rather than every disputant.
The ordered-transformation and exchange readings are intentionally exploratory analogies, not lexical disambiguations.
